data.detailed_description:
a̴̤͆ ̵͓̂m̸̬̋ ̵̖̇F̴̾ͅ ̴̺͗M̸̻̃ ̷̟̑ạ̵͗ ̵͖̎m̵̪̉ ̷͉͗F̸̅͜ ̴͖̒M̴̟͝ ̶̟͑á̷͎ ̸̻̊m̷͔̅ ̵̦̽F̶̼̍ ̴̪̀M̵̖͝ ̴͎̀a̴̙͠ ̷̬͒m̸̥͋ ̴̧̌F̴̥̓ ̷̠͊M̶̥͒ ̶͍̕a̴͍͝ ̸̺̓ḿ̵̱ ̷́ͅF̴͕̃ ̴͓̋M̴̙͝ ̵̥̔ä̸̬́ ̶̰̅m̷̭̽ ̷̞͑F̴̘̈́ ̸̺͒M̷͔͠ ̴͓́ą̵̂ ̸̕ͅm̶̼̉ ̶͗͜F̷̨̔ ̷͓͊M̴̟̔ ̷̭̊a̶̔͜ ̷̜̍m̴̩̆ ̴͔̇F̴͚̅ ̶͇̒M̴̠̏ ̸̧̛ǎ̷̙ ̶̠̀m̷̼͆ ̶̨̈F̵͎̍ ̵͍͆M̵͖͂ ̷̲͒a̶͎̿ ̶̠̎m̵̨͝ ̸̳̏F̴̨̐ ̶̦̈́M̷͠ͅ ̶̡̽a̸̚͜ ̶͕̚


A biologic supercomputer banished to a lead planet called the "enigma core" awakes from its restless slumber to turn the fabric of reality into an unmaterial broth of pain and suffering. You control a minimum wage school cleaner. Take care of this mess I created.

_Please.

_exhibit 1: D I M E N S I O N | T R A V E L - 異 次 元 旅 行


Whether you need to flee from a risky enemy encounter, restock on modules mid-battle, or validate your sense of free will, a loving twist of the control nipple on your desired input device allows you to smoothly switch to your favorite comfort channel.



_WARNING: ⚠ The network is in pain, don't strain it with your negligence!_ ⚠

_exhibit 2: E X C I S I O N | E X T R A C T I O N - 切 除 | 抽 出


A plethora of unique modules allow you to build elaborate mechanisms to destroy your foes in creative ways. You'll have to adapt your machines to withstand the protests of your unwilling test subjects.



Features:
  • _an aggressively normal art direction_
  • _3 chapters that form a non-linear story_
  • _immediate flesh_
  • _unique module-based combat system to experiment and wreak havoc with_
  • _an extensive track long soundtrack that sounds_
  • _the lobe-grind, for believable and immersive fast travel_

☞ based on a true story ☜

a̴̤͆ ̵͓̂m̸̬̋ ̵̖̇F̴̾ͅ ̴̺͗M̸̻̃ ̷̟̑ạ̵͗ ̵͖̎m̵̪̉ ̷͉͗F̸̅͜ ̴͖̒M̴̟͝ ̶̟͑á̷͎ ̸̻̊m̷͔̅ ̵̦̽F̶̼̍ ̴̪̀M̵̖͝ ̴͎̀a̴̙͠ ̷̬͒m̸̥͋ ̴̧̌F̴̥̓ ̷̠͊M̶̥͒ ̶͍̕a̴͍͝ ̸̺̓ḿ̵̱ ̷́ͅF̴͕̃ ̴͓̋M̴̙͝ ̵̥̔ä̸̬́ ̶̰̅m̷̭̽ ̷̞͑F̴̘̈́ ̸̺͒M̷͔͠ ̴͓́ą̵̂ ̸̕ͅm̶̼̉ ̶͗͜F̷̨̔ ̷͓͊M̴̟̔ ̷̭̊a̶̔͜ ̷̜̍m̴̩̆ ̴͔̇F̴͚̅ ̶͇̒M̴̠̏ ̸̧̛ǎ̷̙ ̶̠̀m̷̼͆ ̶̨̈F̵͎̍ ̵͍͆M̵͖͂ ̷̲͒a̶͎̿ ̶̠̎m̵̨͝ ̸̳̏F̴̨̐ ̶̦̈́M̷͠ͅ ̶̡̽a̸̚͜ ̶͕̚

  • Processor: Intel i3+/AMD @ 2.4GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel i5+/AMD Ryzen Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050ti

  • OS: Ubuntu Equivalent Distro
  • Processor: Intel i3+/AMD @ 2.4GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel i5+/AMD Ryzen Processor
